maria_ops: Heads-up — Grafana alert triggered for eu-west3: spot_surge_risk > 0.2. Seeing short-lived interruptions but not matching usual preempt pattern. @aj_sre any context?
aj_sre: saw it. Interruption spikes for A100-preemptible cohort-3. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/abcd/spot-availability?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west3
liam_infra: might be noisy host maintenance rolling through. Provider maintenance feed shows overlapping windows for eu-west3 on a couple of racks. Pulling provider API for exact host IDs.
devon_mlops: cost signal: ~18% of inference qps in eu-west3 currently on preemptible. If we shift 30% to on-demand for hedging, estimate cost delta ~+42%/hour for those requests. Can we do smarter, granular hedging by pool?
maria_ops: propose probabilistic hedging: compute predicted interruption probability P(pool, t) and set hedged fraction f(pool) = clamp(alpha * P, 0, max_hedge). Simulate expected cost vs SLO impact before applying.
aj_sre: agree. Quick prometheus query to get current eviction rates by pool: 
``` 
prometheus
sum(rate(preemptible_evictions_total{region="eu-west3",gpu="a100"}[5m])) by (pool)
/
sum(rate(preemptible_allocated_total{region="eu-west3",gpu="a100"}[5m])) by (pool)
```
liam_infra: i'm going to spin up a small hedging controller test: weighted-hedge-v2 in the staging cluster and restrict to low-traffic shards (shard 42-47). Will tag which nodes are affected.
devon_mlops: quick expected-cost model for the sim: 
```
# per-second expected cost for a cohort
expected_cost = f * cost_on_demand + (1-f) * cost_preemptible + (1-f) * P * cost_recovery
# where cost_recovery includes restart and KV-cache warm-up penalty
```
maria_ops: added runbook note and a canary route. Also adding an alert to avoid hedging flaps: "hedge_switch_rate{region=\"eu-west3\"} > 5/min" will block automated changes for 10m.
alertbot: [ALERT] eu-west3 hedge_controller restart detected: deploy/weighted-hedge-v2 started by liam_infra at 2034567915
aj_sre: ran a short sim with current traces: with alpha=2 and max_hedge=0.3 => overall latency p95 +12ms, cost +9% for the region, predicted SLO violation risk down from 3% to ~0.5%. Seems acceptable for critical models.
devon_mlops: plan: 6h canary on shards 42-47, rollout policy linear 10% -> 30% with 30min steps, auto-rollback if SLO breach spike >1% or error-rate > 0.5% above baseline. I'll attach the sim notebook shortly.
maria_ops: noted. i'll post a short summary to #incidents and tag product owners for affected models. Will also add telemetry to track hedge efficacy: cost_delta, SLO_delta, interruption_correlation. :thumbsup:
